sources.evidence: Exact preview identifier; last-documented inputs, output, token limits, Thinking and Function calling. Explicitly says the preview shut down May 25, 2026. sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: March 3, 2026 launches this exact preview. May 7 separately launches gemini-3.1-flash-lite GA. May 25 records shutdown of gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview. Rechecked October 27: GA and migration are documented, but no explicit unchanged-weight identity statement or numerical size is provided.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite model card - March 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The March card explicitly identifies Gemini 3 Pro as the model dependency, architecture and training-data reference. Its complete benchmark table gives price, speed and capability results, with no total or active parameter count. The named dependency is stronger than generic family resemblance, but the referenced Pro model also has no published count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card - updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-card review: the named Gemini 3 Pro base has sparse MoE architecture with qualitative token routing, but no numerical total, expert dimensions or active count. The May revision lists Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite among dependent models; no count-bearing specification is available for inheritance.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Model Card - updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full seven-page review of the May-updated PDF. It explicitly states Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is based on Gemini 3 Pro, with architecture and training-data references to that base. It retains March evaluation results and provides no nominal total or active count. May card revision alone does not prove that preview and GA weights are identical.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Model Card - July 21, 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 complete later-card check: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite names 3.1 Flash-Lite as its base. Its exact 3.1 comparison column reports prices, benchmarks and safety, not total or active parameters; it does not identify the retired preview checkpoint or supply a numerical count.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash Model Card - September 2, 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-card parameter and exact-model search found no numerical total or active count for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite. The documented 3.7-to-3.8 lineage supplies no count for this older preview.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card - October 13, 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 complete decoded card check found no total or active parameter count for this preview or its named Pro base. Argon is a new model rather than a fine-tune of a previous model; no numerical size is transferred backward.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Google service terms govern API access and restrict extraction or replication of model weights. Supports proprietary hosted-service classification, rather than a license to distribute model weights.

sources.evidence: March 3, 2026 announcement explicitly introduces preview access through the Gemini API, AI Studio and Vertex AI for high-volume workloads. Reopened October 27: speed, cost and benchmark comparisons are supplied, without numerical model size or an unchanged known-size base.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-ID, model-name, total-size and named-base searches found no supported nominal count. The original and updated cards explicitly identify Gemini 3 Pro as a base, but neither it nor Flash-Lite has a published count in the reviewed material. GA lifecycle continuity supplies no numerical size or explicit unchanged-weight statement. Null reflects missing numerical evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count searches and original/later primary comparison checks found no numerical active size. MoE routing is qualitative, without expert sizes or routing quantities sufficient to establish a count. Exact-preview evaluation methods and later benchmark/safety tables provide no activated-parameter column; total size, throughput and thinking settings are not substituted.

patch.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview

research_notes: Inspected the original Models.dev lead, exact preview docs, launch announcement, release notes, original HTML and May-updated PDF cards, explicit Pro architecture reference, and July/September/October later cards.

Searched the exact model name with parameters, total parameters, active parameters, architecture, transformer, interpretability, training research, sparse autoencoder and transcoder, including deepmind.google, research.google, storage.googleapis.com and arxiv.org. No first-party exact-model numerical parameter disclosure was located; this is a bounded search, not an exhaustive absence claim.
The July comparison names Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite without a preview identifier. It was checked for disclosures only; no later stable or successor capabilities were used to overwrite the preview specs.

October 27 parameter re-audit: repeated exact-preview ID/name searches for total, active, activated, billion, base-model, distillation and unchanged-preview/GA relationships. Reopened exact API, March launch, release notes, original HTML and updated PDF cards, and inspected later 3.5 Flash-Lite/3.8 Flash/Argon cards and the full Argon safety report. No applicable nominal count found.

The original March evaluation appendix explicitly identifies the preview ID and was checked in full. The May GA changelog establishes release succession, without an explicit unchanged-weight identity statement. No stable or successor count/capability is silently transferred.
summary: Fresh parameter re-audit completed October 27, 2026. Retain explicit null total and active counts after renewed exact-model searches, original and updated cards, named Pro-base review, original preview evaluation appendix and later first-party comparisons. The explicit Pro dependency supplies no count because the base also lacks a numerical disclosure. Preserve preview identity and all unrelated field assessments.
